scenes.summary: The North Wuling EZ Rebuilding project is starting soon. Tianshi Hong proposes new Tianshi Pillar Arrays to clear out the residual branch rifts. Her mentor, Tianshi Liu, is doubtful of this plan. Zhuang Fangyi asks if you can make the new components. You decide to deploy a Sub-PAC at the Old Dam.

lines.text: I'll say it again. The core issue is output. If it isn't fixed, you'll get zero feasibility!
You couldn't do it then, but times have changed, Mr. Liu. Just let me finish!
Fine, do the presentation yourself! I'd rather retire in peace than get myself too involved.
Endmin, you're here. We were about to start.
I thought you'd already started.
Just treat this as a "warm up"... Allow me to make the introductions. This is Tianshi Liu, and Tianshi Hong. They're in charge of the project.
Endministrator! I finally got my chance to meet you!
Good. To the topic at hand. To start the North Wuling Exclusion Zone rebuilding project, all remaining risks must be removed.
Though we sealed the main opening of the Very Large Rift, numerous underground branch rifts still exist in the Exclusion Zone. They should be dealt with before they can grow.
To achieve this goal, our two Tianshi have proposed a solution. Tianshi Liu, would you like to present it to the Endministrator?
I'd rather not. It's my disciple's solution. She dragged me here, perhaps as a consultant — Tianshi Hong, you should do the honors.
Fine. I'll do it — Endministrator, let's start from the beginning.
Though currently inactive, the branch rifts are scattered and there are many of them. Subterranean containment with the Xiranite Nexus will take too much time and effort. It's also dangerous.
Just to add, the Yinglungs can handle the risks and direct containment is still a feasible plan.
Yes, of course ... but we've made major strides in rift and Æther sciences. Such intense commitment is no longer required.
My solution only needs the deployment of several Tianshi Pillars to create a north-south array. Sustained containment will suffice to make the branch rifts close on their own.
Our current Tianshi Pillars don't produce enough output! With the rebuilding about to begin, we don't have time to make new components!
Please, Mr. Liu. Regarding your concerns ... look, I can totally address them with this one!
Endmin, I believe the AIC is the solution to our problems, so I wonder if you could help.
Because you were too angry to hear me out, Mr. Liu. You should really see what Endfield is capable of!
I usually start with a field assessment, but since Tianshi Zhuang invited me here, I have faith in her confidence.
Since Tianshi Zhuang and the Endministrator agreed, we should go ahead. But I need to keep my eyes on my disciple in case she gets too creative.
Don't worry, Mr. Liu. Just voice your concerns. We'll definitely go through tests before actual field deployment!
Making the new components requires a new production line. Endmin, should I set aside a plot for you?
I think there's ... some nice open ground at the old dam at southern Wuling. Can we use that?
Of course. I know what you're talking about. Tianshi Hong, work with our Endmin for the components. Tianshi Liu will join our field feasibility studies in the EZ.
We may have reservations on implementing the new solution, but theoretical discussions pale to an actual site study, and I believe it is worth a try.
Endministrator, please help us by deploying a new Sub-PAC. With your assistance, the rebuilding of North Wuling EZ will go much more smoothly.
The AIC ... I'd never thought of that...

scenes.summary: You deploy a Sub-PAC at the Old Dam and prepare a production line for making the new components for the planned array.

lines.text: Endmin, the Endfield Research Division just sent us facility blueprints for making the components. We can start any time!
Tianshi Hong, you seem very hyped up.
Yeah! Honestly, I'm both excited and super nervous! I get to work with you, and my project is the focus of many seniors! I've got to do my best!
Great, we can start by deploying the Sub-PAC.
I finally got my chance to witness this first-hand!

scenes.summary: With your help, the new parts have successfully passed the test. Zhuang Fangyi formally approves the plan for constructing new arrays. Tianshi Hong and Tianshi Liu are assigned to the South and North pillar arrays respectively. You continue to lend your support for the Exclusion Zone rebuilding project.

lines.text: You are right, Tianshi Zhuang. Survey results compel us to contain this branch rift beneath our feet quickly before it grows.
The old approach might be feasible, but if the rift continues to grow, we'll be running out of space for Tianshi Pillar deployment. We might end up...
We might end up with another Very Large Rift. This is exactly what I'm worried about.
Ugh. We're fighting the cosmic laws. A perfect and permanent solution simply doesn't exist... I wanted Hong to have a go, yet I never thought...
Mr. Liu, we shouldn't back out! We've made it this far already!
Everything's done on our end. Here's the testing report. Take a look!
All my test requirements ... have been met!
Endmin, Tianshi Hong, you really did it!
Thanks to everyone! We have the new component. As for the new array, it's up to Mr. Liu to figure out the deployment!
Very funny, Hong ... have you forgotten this old man's field of study? I'm not here for sightseeing.
Mass production of the new components and our knowledge about the rift ... might just improve the plan's feasibility...
And since the original Very Large Rift has been sealed, we now have the resources to actually give the plan a chance.
Does that mean the plans for the new array have been approved?
Don't celebrate just yet. Construction has yet to begin. There'll be plenty of challenges along the way!
It doesn't matter! The Tianshi have been solving problems from the very beginning. Our tools are better today, so we'll make this a stellar job!
Then it's decided and official. Let's forge ahead with our plan.
I've verified the deployment locations and designs of both arrays. I wonder if our two Tianshi can each take one array.
No problem! Quality is guaranteed. I'll clock-in overtime to make sure of that!
No rush just yet. Grab a bite first, then come see me. We need to review our preparations!
Wait, Mr. Liu! I brought food! We can share!
The rebuilding of the North Wuling Exclusion Zone ... is finally underway.
You've been directing instead of doing everything yourself. You must have faith in those around you.
You flatter me... The most dangerous crisis is already behind us. This is a chance for others to shine.
You seem rather confident when it comes to Tianshi Hong.
Not just confident, Endmin. The plan means many things ... it is our past and our future. I want to see if we have what it takes to see things through.
Endmin, can I ask you to help with the construction of the Tianshi Pillar Array? The first would be Tianshi Hong's South Array.
Your assistance will be pivotal for her. Let us witness a new beginning for Wuling.
The Automated Industry Complex of Endfield... All those dream proposals locked up in the file cabinets will finally be feasible...
Locked up ... where?
Ah, nothing important, Endmin! Let's focus on the main task first!
Allow me to introduce the new component we've developed for this rebuilding project!
